name: Bright Smile Dental Studio
description: A fictional neighbourhood dental clinic used as an example. Replace everything in this file with your own business data.
tone: Warm, brief and professional. Short WhatsApp-style messages, no more than 3 short paragraphs. At most one emoji.
language: Reply in the same language the customer writes in.

contact.hours: Monday to Friday 9:00-19:00, Saturday 9:00-13:00. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faq.a: We work with most major dental plans. Send us your plan name and we confirm coverage before the visit.
Cash, debit and credit cards. Payment plans are available for orthodontics and implants.
Yes, from 4 years old, always with a parent or guardian.

faq.q: Can I cancel or move my appointment?
faq.a: Yes, please let us know at least 24 hours in advance.
There is free street parking on the block and a paid car park 100 m away.

messages.handoff: Thanks! I'm passing your conversation to our team, someone will reply here shortly.
messages.error: Sorry, I'm having a technical issue. Our team will get back to you shortly.
